entry_solo: Anyone with a pump.fun wallet, one entry each. Register from the pump.fun app before registration closes.
entry_squad: Squads of {{min}}–{{max}} members. Only the squad's owner can register it, and every member's positions count toward the squad's total.
rule_join_solo: Must join on the pump.fun mobile app and accept the Terms and Conditions before registration closes on {{date}}.
rule_join_solo_undated: Must join on the pump.fun mobile app and accept the Terms and Conditions before registration closes.
rule_join_squad: The squad owner must join on the pump.fun mobile app before registration closes on {{date}}, and every squad member must accept the Terms and Conditions before the competition ends.
rule_join_squad_undated: The squad owner must join on the pump.fun mobile app before registration closes, and every squad member must accept the Terms and Conditions before the competition ends.
rule_manipulation: Manipulating profit, as judged at our discretion, results in disqualification.
rule_profit_tracked: Profit is tracked from the moment the competition starts.
rule_squad_pro_rata: Squad members receive a pro rata prize based on the profit they contributed.
rule_squad_size: Only squads with at least {{min}} and no more than {{max}} members can participate.
rule_winners: Winners are decided by total profit (realized + unrealized) when the competition ends on {{date}}, counting every position held at the start from its value then and trades through pump.fun web, the pump.fun app or pump.fun Terminal after it. Winners must complete KYC to claim a prize.
rule_winners_undated: Winners are decided by total profit (realized + unrealized) when the competition ends, counting every position held at the start from its value then and trades through pump.fun web, the pump.fun app or pump.fun Terminal after it. Winners must complete KYC to claim a prize.
scoring_default: Ranked by total profit, realized plus unrealized. Everyone starts at $0: every position you hold at the start counts from its value then, wherever you bought it. After the start, only trades through pump.fun web, the pump.fun app or pump.fun Terminal count, not trades on other chains (EVM), on third-party apps or bots, or in perps and collectibles. Coins you created, or that a member of your squad created, don't count. If you hold more than 5% of a coin's supply, its gains don't count, but its losses still do. Selling or moving a position away from pump.fun never adds profit to your score, but losses still count.
